result: Built the Starknet Cairo workspace in starknet/ and compiled the protocol contracts, shared types, libraries, and supporting mocks successfully.
Implemented the Starknet circuit modules for stealth address derivation, nullifier generation, fixed-depth Merkle membership verification, and the combined Cairo verifier path.
Ran the Starknet Foundry test suite and confirmed 7 passing tests covering stealth derivation, nullifiers, Merkle proofs, campaign creation, funding, successful claims, and double-claim prevention.

Added a Node.js relayer service in starknet/relayer/ that accepts off-chain claim submissions, verifies claimant authorization, submits the claim from the relayer wallet, and returns the Starknet transaction hash.

Replaced the prior EVM wallet and contract interaction layer with Starknet.js integration, added Argent X and Braavos wallet support, and updated the claim flow to send locally generated proof data to the relayer instead of submitting directly from the user wallet.

Created starknet/scripts/deploy.ts to compile Cairo contracts, declare and deploy ZusProtocol plus the verifier to Starknet testnet, persist addresses to starknet/deployments.json, and print deployment outputs.
